u_b\mathrm{bind}[O\mapsto\mathcal N(0,A_O^{-1})]\). The source densities are determined Lebesgue-a.e. The chosen \(q_b\) are the actual conditioned-Haar averages of the full Gaussian precision density. Their nonnegativity, measurability, genuine L1, mass one and actual-law identities are obtained internally from the canonical producer. \(\delta\) is normalized event TV, not the unnormalized variation norm. Affinity L1/range, the TV comparison and B.7 are internal dependencies, never caller hypotheses. p_O(x)= rac{\sqrt{\det A_O}}{(2\pi)^{n/2}}e^{-x^	op A_Ox/2},\quad q_b(x)=\int p_O(x)\,d

decoder_context: EuclideanSpace real (Fin n) is real n-dimensional Euclidean space with its standard l2 norm, Borel structure and Euclidean Lebesgue volume. Fin n indexes coordinates from zero through n-1. WithLp.ofLp is the coordinate representation.

The orthogonal group is full real O(n), both determinant signs, with its matrix Borel structure. Measure.haarMeasure(top : TopologicalSpace.PositiveCompacts G) is canonical normalized full-group Haar probability.

Measure.restrict is restriction to the displayed set. Scalar multiplication of measures uses extended nonnegative real scalars. Measure.bind integrates the displayed measure kernel against its input measure. Measure.withDensity of a nonnegative extended-real function is the measure whose measurable-set values are its set lintegrals under the base measure.

multivariateGaussian mean m matrix C is the pushforward of canonical stdGaussian by z -> m + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (CFC.sqrt C) z. Its covariance interpretation holds for positive semidefinite C. Matrix inverse is standard totalized matrix inverse.

Integrable is genuine real Bochner absolute integrability. The displayed integrals with real integrands are real Bochner integrals; unspecified measure is volume on the displayed Euclidean carrier. Real n/2 powers use Real.rpow and real division; natural powers have natural exponents. ENNReal.ofReal maps a real number to its nonnegative extended-real truncation. Real division/inverse are totalized at zero.

Measure.real B is the real value (Measure B).toReal. The supremum ranges over exactly the displayed real absolute event differences with measurable B. No TV abbreviation or independent supplied estimate occurs.

/-!
# The actual single-block affinity bound (Eq25)

Zhou--Suzuki, arXiv:2610.20492v1, Appendix B.2.3, Ex68--69 and Eq25.
The actual determinant-conditioned Gaussian bind laws and their actual density
representatives instantiate the single shared normalized-density comparison.
B.7 and the scalar log inequality then yield both exact Eq25 inequalities.
Only n>=3 and kappa>=4 are public assumptions; analytic ingredients are internal.
Actual block product laws, tensorization, amplification, oracle/precision/cost
adapters and both main lower bounds remain separate.
-/

theorem single_block_affinity_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let qpos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νpos
    let qneg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νneg
    let Ppos := νpos.bind γ
    let Pneg := νneg.bind γ
    let δ : ℝ := sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      MeasurableSet B ∧ z = |Ppos.real B - Pneg.real B|}
    let a : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (qpos x * qneg x)
    Integrable (fun x => Real.sqrt (qpos x * qneg x)) volume ∧
    0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 ∧ δ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - a ^ 2) ∧
    a ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) ∧
    Real.sqrt (1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) ≤
      Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let μ := orthogonalHaar n
  let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
    {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
  let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
    {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
  let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
    fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
      (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
  let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
    fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
      (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
      Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
  let qpos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νpos
  let qneg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νneg
  let Ppos := νpos.bind γ
  let Pneg := νneg.bind γ
  let δ : ℝ := sSup {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
    MeasurableSet B ∧ z = |Ppos.real B - Pneg.real B|}
  let a : ℝ := ∫ x, Real.sqrt (qpos x * qneg x)
  have hd := MixtureDensities.actual_mixture_densities hn hκ
  dsimp only at hd
  have hc := normalized_density_tv_affinity (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (fun x => (hd.1 x).1) (fun x => (hd.1 x).2)
    hd.2.1 hd.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.2.1
    hd.2.2.2.2.2.1 hd.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  dsimp only at hc
  have hreal (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ)
      (hq0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ q x) (hqm : Measurable q)
      (B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
      (volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q x))).real B =
        ∫ x in B, q x := by
    rw [measureReal_def, withDensity_apply _ hB]
    exact (integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hq0) hqm.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
  have hpos (B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
      Ppos.real B = ∫ x in B, qpos x := by
    have he : Ppos = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qpos x)) :=
      hd.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
    rw [he]
    exact hreal qpos (fun x => (hd.1 x).1) hd.2.1 B hB
  have hneg (B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (hB : MeasurableSet B) :
      Pneg.real B = ∫ x in B, qneg x := by
    have he : Pneg = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qneg x)) :=
      hd.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
    rw [he]
    exact hreal qneg (fun x => (hd.1 x).2) hd.2.2.1 B hB
  have hset : {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B ∧
        z = |Ppos.real B - Pneg.real B|} =
      {z : ℝ | ∃ B : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), MeasurableSet B ∧
        z = |(∫ x in B, qpos x) - (∫ x in B, qneg x)|} := by
    ext z
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨B, hB, hz⟩
    · exact ⟨B, hB, (by rw [← hpos B hB, ← hneg B hB]; exact hz)⟩
    · exact ⟨B, hB, (by rw [hpos B hB, hneg B hB]; exact hz)⟩
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := hc.2.1
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := hc.2.2.1
  have htv : δ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - a ^ 2) := by
    dsimp only [δ]
    rw [hset]
    exact hc.2.2.2.2.2
  have hb7 := SingleBlockSeparation.single_block_separation hn hκ
  dsimp only at hb7
  have hlow : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ) ≤ δ :=
    hb7.1.trans hb7.2
  have hrad : 0 ≤ 1 - a ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsquare : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) ^ 2 ≤
      1 - a ^ 2 := by
    have he := hlow.trans htv
    have hpos : 0 ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ) := by
      positivity
    have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hrad
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (1 - a ^ 2)]
  have hexp : Real.exp (-(5 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ) ^ 2 =
      Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ) := by
    rw [pow_two, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hfirst : a ≤ Real.sqrt
      (1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    rw [mul_pow, hexp] at hsquare
    nlinarith
  let t : ℝ := (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn)
  have hs0 : 0 < Real.sqrt κ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  have ht1 : t < 1 := by
    have he : Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
        (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) hs0.le)
    dsimp only [t]
    linarith
  have hlog : Real.log (1 - t) ≤ -t := by
    have he := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht1)
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (1 - t) = Real.exp (Real.log (1 - t) / 2) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_def_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr ht1)]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hlast : Real.sqrt
      (1 - (1 / 4 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) ≤
      Real.exp (-(1 / 8 : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(10 * (n : ℝ)) / Real.sqrt κ)) := by
    calc
      _ = Real.exp (Real.log (1 - t) / 2) := hsqrt
      _ ≤ Real.exp (-t / 2) := Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by linarith)
      _ = _ := by congr 1; dsimp only [t]; ring
  exact ⟨hc.1, ha0, ha1, htv, hfirst, hlast⟩

end AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.SingleBlockAffinity

steps.title: Identify the actual density integrals

reconstruction.text:
For every natural number n, under the hypothesis 3 ≤ n, and then for every real number κ, under the hypothesis 4 ≤ κ, make the following definitions in the displayed order.

Let E = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), the real n-dimensional Euclidean space with coordinates indexed by Fin n = {0,…,n−1}, its standard ℓ² norm, Borel structure, and Euclidean Lebesgue measure volume. Let G = Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ, the full real orthogonal group O(n), including both determinant signs, with its matrix Borel structure. Write O also for the underlying real n-by-n matrix of an element O ∈ G. Let μ be the canonical Haar measure normalized on the whole compact group G; thus μ is the full-group Haar probability measure.

Define
  νpos = 2 · (μ restricted to {O ∈ G : det O = 1}),
  νneg = 2 · (μ restricted to {O ∈ G : det O = −1}),
where the multiplier 2 is an extended nonnegative real scalar acting on measures. For use in the following definitions, abbreviate the real matrix expression
  A(O) = ((κ + 1)/2) Iₙ − ((κ − 1)/4)(O + Oᵀ).
Define γ : G → Measure(E) by letting γ(O) be multivariateGaussian with mean 0 ∈ E and matrix parameter A(O)⁻¹. Precisely, the multivariateGaussian convention is the pushforward of canonical standard Gaussian measure on E under z ↦ 0 + Matrix.toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt(A(O)⁻¹))(z). The matrix inverse is the standard totalized matrix inverse; the covariance interpretation of this Gaussian convention is the one valid for positive semidefinite matrix parameters.

For O ∈ G and x ∈ E, with v = WithLp.ofLp(x) its coordinate vector, define
  p(O,x) = [√(det A(O)) / (2π)^(n/2)] · exp(−(v · (A(O)v))/2).
In the denominator, n is coerced to a real number and (2π)^(n/2) is a real power, with real division by 2, not a power with a natural-number exponent. The products O + Oᵀ, A(O)v, and v · (A(O)v) are respectively matrix addition, matrix-vector multiplication, and the coordinate dot product. Define the real functions on E
  qpos(x) = ∫_G p(O,x) dνpos(O),
  qneg(x) = ∫_G p(O,x) dνneg(O).
Then define
  Ppos = νpos.bind γ,
  Pneg = νneg.bind γ,
namely the measures obtained by integrating the displayed measure kernel γ against νpos and νneg, respectively.

Define the real numbers
  δ = sup {z ∈ ℝ : there exists a measurable set B ⊆ E such that z = |(Ppos(B)).toReal − (Pneg(B)).toReal|},
  a = ∫_E √(qpos(x)qneg(x)) dvolume(x).
The set in this supremum ranges over exactly those absolute differences for measurable events B. The notation (P(B)).toReal means the real value of the extended nonnegative measure value P(B); the supremum is the real conditionally complete supremum. No separate event-distance estimate is assumed.

Then x ↦ √(qpos(x)qneg(x)) is integrable with respect to volume, and all of the following hold:
  0 ≤ a,
  a ≤ 1,
  δ ≤ √(1 − a²),
  a ≤ √(1 − (1/4) exp(−(10n)/√κ)),
  √(1 − (1/4) exp(−(10n)/√κ)) ≤ exp(−(1/8) exp(−(10n)/√κ)).
In these last expressions n is coerced to ℝ, and the exponent 2 in a² is the natural-number exponent 2. All displayed integrals of real-valued functions are real Bochner integrals, and integrability means genuine absolute Bochner integrability. Every unspecified Euclidean integral uses volume. Square roots are the nonnegative real square roots with the totalized real convention, and real division and inverse have their totalized conventions at zero.
